name: dito (identity host)
description: did:vh hosting for *.did.md: how many identities, how fast, how big

limits.createPerHour.description: New identities the host accepts in any hour, from everyone together. 0 closes sign-up.

limits.maxIdentities.description: The host takes no new identity once it keeps this many.

names.reserved.description: Names that cannot be registered, besides the built-in list (postmaster, support, didmail ...).

limits.maxLogBytes.description: The largest did.jsonl the host takes. A normal identity's log is a few KB.

limits.maxJsonBytes.description: The largest routing.json and other small bodies.

limits.maxConcurrentValidations.description: Logs checked at the same time; more are answered 503.

stop-identity.description: Stop an identity: its documents are no longer served (404) and it cannot be written. Nothing is deleted; release-identity undoes it. The CDN may serve a copy for 30 seconds.
